title: Genome
description: The complete forensic reconstruction of a single garment from a set of photographs. Versioned: every genome records the schemaVersion it was produced under so old genomes keep parsing as the schema evolves.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema. Clients branch on the major.

id.description: Opaque unique id for this genome.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp the genome was assembled.

genes.description: One GeneResult per extractor that ran. Order is not significant.

timings.description: Per-extractor wall-clock timings in milliseconds, keyed by gene id. An instrument touch — surfaced in the report.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues raised during assembly (e.g. a shot was missing so a gene degraded).

Tier.description: The honesty tier of a claim — the soul of kapra. MEASURED: computed directly from pixels, deterministic, reproducible. ESTIMATED: a model prediction with a confidence/interval. INFERRED: a hypothesis reasoned from the measured+estimated layers, explicitly labelled as inference.

ShotType.description: The role a photograph plays in analysis.

uri.description: Where the (normalized) image can be fetched for the report. May be a data URI or a storage path.

capture.description: What normalization was applied during capture. Affects how much to trust MEASURED color/scale.

Interval.description: A confidence interval for an ESTIMATED value.

level.description: Confidence level the interval covers, e.g. 0.9 for a 90% interval.

Evidence.description: A pointer to the measurement that justifies a gene's value. No claim ships without at least one.

kind.description: The sort of evidence being cited.

value.description: The raw numeric/structured measurement, when applicable.

vizRef.description: Id of a VizSpec on this or another gene that visualizes this evidence.

VizSpec.description: A declarative description of how the UI should render the proof for a gene. The web app owns the rendering; the engine owns the data.

data.description: Viz-kind-specific payload. Shape is validated by the renderer, not this schema, so new viz kinds don't require a schema bump.

GeneResult.description: The output of one Extractor: a single gene of the garment's genome.

label.description: Human-facing name of the gene, e.g. 'Weave Structure'.

value.description: The structured reading. Shape depends on the gene.

summary.description: One-line human-readable statement of the finding.
